crossRefs.note: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab, I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight…
Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of…
He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his…
Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you…
But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
“Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that…
In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be…
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

parallels.note: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
translations.bsb: Therefore Saul sent David away and gave him command of a thousand men. David led the troops out to battle and back,
translations.kjv: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
translations.asv: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
